final: WITH c AS (SELECT co.constructorId, co.nationality, COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) AS cnt FROM constructors co LEFT JOIN constructorStandings cs ON cs.constructorId = co.constructorId GROUP BY co.constructorId, co.nationality) SELECT constructorId, nationality, cnt AS record_count, cnt - (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) FROM c) AS diff FROM c ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
